title: Bridging the Fairness Gap: Enhancing Pre-trained Models with LLM-Generated Sentences

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated using standard bias benchmark indicators including SEAT (Sentence Encoder Association Test), StereoSet (measuring Language Modeling, Stereotype Score, and ICAT), and CrowS-Pairs. Additionally, qualitative evaluation is performed using t-SNE visualizations to examine the spatial correlation and relative distances between gender-specific attribute words (male/female) and neutral target words in the model's hidden space.
Measured using compiled racial word lists evaluated against standard bias benchmarks (SEAT, StereoSet, and CrowS-Pairs).
